name: quick-reply
description: One-click replies above the prompt: the options Claude just offered, Yes, Go with your recommendation, Continue, Pass, Fail and Skip when Claude asks for a verdict, and the next wayfinder ticket.

questionReplies.title: Replies to a question
questionReplies.description: Shown after Claude asks something, separated by |.

idleReplies.title: Replies otherwise
idleReplies.description: Shown after any other answer, separated by |; empty hides the band then.

wayfinderNext.title: Offer the next wayfinder ticket
wayfinderNext.description: After a wayfinder turn closes a ticket or charts a map, the band offers Next ticket: one press runs /clear, then /wayfinder with the map.

modelChoice.title: System One models
modelChoice.description: Which System One model reads how each of Claude's answers ends, to choose the buttons. Local only: Laya on this machine, or the built-in reading as before. Local first: Laya, and TypeSafe's hosted Jev while Laya is unavailable. Hosted first: Jev, and Laya while Jev is unavailable. Jev receives the last 8,000 characters of every answer Claude gives and the labels of the choices found in it, once after each answered turn.

jevApiKey.title: Jev API key
jevApiKey.description: Your key for TypeSafe's hosted Jev, from console.typesafe.ai. Sent only to api.typesafe.ai, and only while System One models allows Jev. A changed key takes effect once the mod reloads.

layaPort.title: Laya port
layaPort.description: The port laya-serve listens on at 127.0.0.1 (its LAYA_PORT).
